newsitem.title: USA: Abbott in alliance with Toshiba.
newsitem.headline: Abbott in alliance with Toshiba.

text.p: Abbott Laboratories Inc said Wednesday it has formed an alliance with Toshiba Corp.

The alliance covers the development, manufacture and distribution of the first of a new generation of Toshiba-manufactured clinical chemistry analyzers, and a current Toshiba analyzer, the TBA-200FR. Financial terms were not disclosed.

The new generation of modular mid- to high-volume clinical chemistry analyzers is designed to be integrated with a new family of Abbott immunoassay systems, known as ARCHITECT, Abbott said. Abbott will be previewing the first product in the ARCHITECT family later this month at the annual meeting of the American Association of Clinical Chemistry.
The TBA-200FR is targeted at the mid- and high-volume segments of the clinical chemistry market, Abbott said.

Toshiba will manufacture and supply the TBA-200FR and the new ARCHITECT analyzer to Abbott on an exclusive basis, and Abbott has exclusive distribution rights for the analyzers in all areas of the world, except for Japan, Korea and Taiwan.
